main_measure.name: slope of excess forward 10-bar log return on forecast, short-bar non-overlapping blocks
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 confirms (with mean excess < 0 and higher decline share); t <= -2 rejects; else inconclusive; < 15 short blocks inconclusive

supporting_check.name: share of negative 10-bar returns: short blocks minus all blocks

decided_by: The slope t-statistic lies between -2 and +2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The baseline is the mean forward 10-bar log return over every bar with a full in-window forward return, the regression and the shares use the per-window grid at positions 0, 10, 20, ..., the slope t is the OLS slope over its standard error, the mean excess in the confirm rule is taken on the short grid blocks, and a t >= +2 that fails the other confirm conditions is treated as inconclusive.
